duration.text: The Geology Engineering at Hohai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1388 USD/per year ￥ 10000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Front page of passport. If the current validity period of your passport does not meet the requirements (the validity period is later than September 2025), please promptly apply for a new passport. 2. Notarized proof of the highest academic degree. If the applicant is a student, they must submit a projected graduation certificate or student status certificate issued by their current school. 3. Academic transcript. It includes all courses taken during the high school years. 4. Language proficiency certificate. HSK 4-level or above certificate or equivalent proof of Chinese language proficiency; 5. Study Plan in China. This should include personal information, educational background, and study plan, etc. It should be written in Chinese, and the length should be around 800 words. The template download link is https://ie.hhu.edu.cn/2024/1012/c14691a289779/page.htm; 6. Recommendation Letters. Submit two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors. The letters should be written in either Chinese or English. Please have the recommenders sign and provide their valid contact information. Template download link: https://ie.hhu.edu.cn/2024/1012/c14691a289776/page.htm; 7. Copy of the "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" (Keep the original for yourself. This form is uniformly printed by the Chinese Health Quarantine Department and must be filled out in English). Applicants should conduct the examination strictly in accordance with the items required in the "Foreigner Physical Examination Form". An incomplete form, one without a photo attached or without the signature and seal of a doctor and hospital, and one without the original seal is invalid. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months. The download link for the form is https://ie.hhu.edu.cn/2021/0322/c14691a220524/page.htm; 8. Certificate of No Criminal Record. Applicants are required to submit a valid certificate of no criminal record issued by the local public security authority. This certificate should generally be a document issued within the past 6 months prior to the application submission. Graduates can provide proof of their good academic performance during their studies. 9. Personal Resume. Provide a detailed account of your continuous study experience since high school. Those who have studied in China should include all their study history. 10. All scanned copies of visa and residence permit related to China. If you have never been to China, the pages from your passport can be used instead. 11. Financial capability proof. One of the following documents: proof of family savings, proof of family property, proof of income from parents/guardians. It is recommended to be at least $5,000 or more. 12. Signed personal commitment letter. The download link for the personal commitment letter is https://ie.hhu.edu.cn/2024/1017/c14691a290035/page.htm.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health. Comply with Chinese laws and regulations, respect Chinese customs and traditions. For those who were Chinese citizens originally and later acquired foreign nationality, follow the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education; 2. Applicants for a bachelor's degree must have a high school diploma or equivalent educational qualification, and be between 18 and 30 years old. Those under 18 years old are required to submit a guardianship guarantee. The template download link is https://ie.hhu.edu.cn/2021/0322/c14691a220525/page.htm.
